qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Infrastructure construction and support services business operates in competitive tendering markets with low barriers to entry and thin margins (statutory group operating margin 1.5-2.5%). Lacks structural pricing power, failing the 12% GAAP ROIC hurdle.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (Moat Archetype 'None' & ROIC < 12%, REJECT). Infrastructure contractor operates with thin 1.5-2.5% statutory operating margins in competitive bidding, lacking structural pricing power or excess returns on capital.
